en: Homage to the one who delights in a single dharma, who dwells alone at the edge of the forest, who has become the sole eye of the world, and the sole kinsman of the world. 1.
Homage be to the supreme among bipeds, who reveals the two truths,
who has no second companion, and who manifests non-duality; homage to him who is endowed with the three concentrations and who embodies the Three Jewels.

Homage to the one who has crossed the flood of the three types of suffering, the teacher of the three worlds. Homage to you, the master of the fourfold treatise, the one who provides the fourfold explanation, the one liberated from the four yokes, and the knower of the four truths.
Homage to him who is detached from the five aggregates, who has discerned the five faculties,
who is free from the five hindrances, and who cuts off the five destinies; homage to him who has crossed the flood of the six sense-faculties and who dwells constantly in the six [perfections].

Homage to you who are complete in the six perfections and possess the six superknowledges. Homage to you who possess the jewel of the seven factors of enlightenment, who bestow the seven riches of the noble ones, who are free from the seven constituent parts [of worldly existence], and who cut off the seven states of rebirth.

Homage to the one born of the eightfold path, who knows the eight types of persons, who dispels the eight worldly concerns, and who eliminates the eight inopportune states; to the one detached from the nine abodes and who has removed the nine forms of malice.
Homage to you who have attained the ninefold pliancy and have realized the nine stages;
homage to you who possess qualities that cannot be taken away by others, who have severed the ten hindrances, who delight in the ten abodes of the noble ones, and who are endowed with the ten powers.
Thus, having honored with words the Noble One, the Protector endowed with the ten powers, whatever merit I have acquired today,
may it [serve] those here who are enveloped by the sufferings of hell, animals, and hungry ghosts.
May it be for the crossing over the ocean of existence for all beings.
The *Ekottarikastotra* is completed; the work of the master Mātṛceṭa.
